[[Public sector banks in India|Indian public sector bank]] headquartered in [[Bandra Kurla Complex]], [[Mumbai]]. Founded in 1906, it has been government-owned since [[Nationalisation of banks in India|nationalisation]] in 1969. BoI is a founding member of [[SWIFT]] (Society for Worldwide Inter Bank Financial Telecommunications), which facilitates provision of cost-effective financial processing and communication services. As of 31 December 2024, Bank of India's total business stands at {{INRConvert|14.46|lc|lk=on}},{{Cite web |date=2025-01-24 |title=Bank of India's Q3FY25 net profit up 35% |url=https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/money-and-banking/bank-of-indias-q3fy25-net-profit-up-35/article43807778346.ece |access-date=2025-01-24 |website=BusinessLine |language=en}} has 5,202 branches and 8166 ATMs & CRM around the world (including 22 overseas branches).{{cite web|url=https://www.bankofindia.co.in/pdf/BOIAnnualREPORT-20-21_01072021.pdf|title=Annual Report of Bank of India|access-date=20 July 2021|archive-date=20 July 2021|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210720055834/https://www.bankofindia.co.in/pdf/BOIAnnualREPORT-20-21_01072021.pdf|url-status=dead}}{{Cite news |last=Reporter |first=BS |date=March 4, 2025 |title=Bank of India adds 111 new branches to expand urban, semi-urban reach |url=https://www.business-standard.com/companies/news/bank-of-india-adds-111-new-branches-to-expand-urban-semi-urban-reach-9832124766_1.html |access-date=March 4, 2025 |work=[[Business Standard]]}} ==History== Bank of India was cofounded on 7 September 1906 by [[Ramnarain Ruia]] (also known as Ramnarain Hurnundrai), [[Sassoon Jacob Hai David]], [[Ratanjee Dadabhoy Tata]], Gordhandas Khattau, [[Jehangir Cowasji Jehangir Readymoney|Sir Cowasjee Jehangir]], [[Lalubhai Samaldas]], Khetsey Khiasey, Jenarrayen Hindoomull Dani, Noordin Ebrahim Noordin, and [[Shapurji Broacha]]{{cite web |title=Bank's Founder Members |url=https://www.bankofindia.co.in/BanksFounderMembers |publisher=Bank of India |access-date=25 November 2019 |archive-date=28 September 2022 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220928025743/https://www.bankofindia.co.in/BanksFounderMembers |url-status=dead }} from [[Mumbai]], India. The Bank was under private ownership and control till 19 July 1969 when it was nationalised along with 13 other banks.{{Cite news|url=https://www.indiainfoline.com/article/news-top-story/vr-iyer-chairperson-managing-director-bank-of-india-115021300132_1.html|title=VR Iyer, Chairperson & Managing Director, Bank of India|last=indiainfoline.com|access-date=27 January 2018|language=en}} Beginning with one office in Mumbai, with a paid-up capital of {{INRConvert|50|l}} and 50 employees, the Bank has made a rapid growth over the years. The bank has over 5,084 branches in India spread over all states and [[Union territory|Union territories]] including specialised branches. These branches are controlled through 54 zonal offices. There are 60 branches, 5 subsidiaries, and 1 joint venture abroad. The bank came out with its maiden public issue in 1997 and follow on Qualified Institutions Placement in February 2008. == Presence == As of 2026 Bank has overseas presence in 15 foreign countries spread over 5 continents with 47 branches/offices including 4 Subsidiaries, 1 Representative office and 1 joint Venture, at key Tokyo,Hong Kong, Singapore, London, Paris, New York, DIFC Dubai and International Banking Unit (IBU) at GIFT City Gandhinagar.https://bankofindia.bank.in/about-us ==CMDs since nationalization== *1969–1970 : Tribhovandas Damodardas Kansara *1970–1975 : J.N.Saxena *1975–1977 : C.P.Shah *1977–1980 : H C Sarkar *1981–1984 : N Vaghul *1984–1986 : T. Bank of India (BoI) is an Indian public sector bank headquartered in Bandra Kurla Complex, Mumbai. Founded in 1906, it has been government-owned since nationalisation in 1969. BoI is a founding member of SWIFT (Society for Worldwide Inter Bank Financial Telecommunications), which facilitates provision of cost-effective financial processing and communication services.
As of 31 December 2024, Bank of India's total business stands at ₹14.46 lakh crore (US$150 billion), has 5,202 branches and 8166 ATMs & CRM around the world (including 22 overseas branches).
